subject: Thomas Massie
query: is thomas massie a republican or democrat
title: Is Thomas Massie a Republican or Democrat? His party, explained
answer: Thomas Massie is a Republican. He has represented Kentucky's 4th Congressional District in the U.S. House since 2012. He lost the Republican primary on May 19, 2026, to Trump-endorsed Ed Gallrein, so his current term ends when the new Congress is sworn in on Jan. 3, 2027.
body:
Massie has often broken with President Donald Trump. The Associated Press reported that he pushed for the release of the Jeffrey Epstein files, criticized the war in Iran and voted against the president's signature tax legislation in 2025. Trump handpicked and endorsed Gallrein, a former Navy SEAL, and said after the primary that Massie "deserves to lose." Gallrein went on to defeat Democrat Melissa Strange for the seat in the Nov. 3, 2026, general election.

On Nov. 9, 2026, Massie filed a privileged resolution with eight articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. Under House rules, leaders must bring the measure up by Wednesday, Nov. 11, although they could move to table it.
in_the_news: Massie, a Kentucky Republican leaving Congress in January, forced a House vote on impeaching Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Nov. 9, 2026.
